name: Arduino Nano
description: Breadboard-friendly ATmega328P board at 16 MHz and 5 V; same chip and pin names as the Uno (D0–D13, A0–A5) plus analog-only A6/A7. Runs real compiled firmware (avr8js). D13 drives the on-board L LED.
